name: filter_bat_oas1

inputs.call: hyphaeon.filter.run_alignment_filter(alignment, tree, alpha_site=0.05, min_k=3, max_span=35, min_oci=0.25, min_run_length=3)
inputs.hyphy: HYPHY 2.5.65(MP) for Darwin on x86_64 x86 AVX SIMD with FMA3 zlib (v1.2.12)

notes: OCI is inline in filter.run_alignment_filter (not a separate function) so this is an end-to-end fixture: baseline LRTs (model, 1e-5) -> MEME p -> scan_hypergeometric_patches -> per-patch consensus codons (pandas mode: lowest codon string on ties) -> per-taxon max mismatch run and count -> top taxon by (run, count) -> OCI = count/total -> artifact if (run>=3 and OCI>=0.25) or run>=4 -> NNN mask -> re-score. artifacts list, masked ranges and cleaned-alignment hash are exact; metrics 1e-5. bat_oas1 yields 1 candidate patch and 0 artifacts, exercising the no-mask path.
